value.rationale: The optional EMA variant lacks the cumulative variant's convex convergence theorem. This exact, parameter-free stability threshold and nonzero quadratic loss floor give a motivated benchmark for whether normalized moment modulation actually suppresses chattering. The cycle remains finite and nonvanishing for every positive fixed learning rate in a nonempty decay range, yet turns repelling above an exact algebraic boundary; this is a meaningful local dynamical classification rather than a generic first-iterate deduction.
